About 47% of the workforce was represented by unions, covering 75 collective‑bargaining agreements with 14 different unions. The company highlighted its focus on safety, noting a 52% reduction in workplace injuries since 2017 and an OSHA recordable injury rate of 0.85, the lowest in its history and roughly twice as good as the industry average.
